# gallon_storage_bag_package — realism QA

Status: **provisional_B_not_certified**. Grades: evidence B, silhouette A, proportions A, colour_texture A, material B, articulation B, physics B, collision A, instances B, cross_view B. Primary visible IoU: 0.920.

Evidence: f2965, f2979, f2980. Camera intrinsics and metric transforms: `../review/calibration.json`. Comparison: `../review/gallon_storage_bag_package_compare.jpg`. Per-frame dimensions, IoU, histogram and mask provenance: `../qa_report.json`.

Changes:
- Added and fitted the third source view; rebaked flexible package printing after the pose correction.
- Rebuilt physical mass estimates from constituent density and thin-shell/contact geometry; updated part COM, affine instance mass and material-specific friction.
- Rebuilt reproducible Blender/GLB meshes and collision geometry; preserved instance and review metadata in standalone rebuilds.
- Corrected the contents identification: clearer frames show a balloon retail bag; retained the legacy file/asset id to avoid breaking references. Re-baked from the better exposed f2980 frame.

Remaining:
- Tentative constitutive parameters and rigid proxy; no validated deformation solver or grasp sequence.
- Mass, contents, friction, restitution and hidden wall thickness are unmeasured priors.
- Static visible-state evidence does not verify actuation force, thread pitch, seal behavior or fracture. Closed-retention constraints require explicit release actions in a runtime importer.
